ruleName: Playing from outside the teeing area
group: Playing from outside the teeing area
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer finishing a shot with her ball obviously placed completely outside the lines set by the tee markers.
imageAlt: Teen girl making a drive with her ball outside the yellow tee markers.

issues: The ball is correctly outside the lines set by the tee markers.
Golf posture, equipment, ethnic appearance, skin tone, clothing colors, and scene all appear accurate.
One golf ball is visible and correctly sized.
Club is a realistic modern driver with correct proportions.
Tee markers are present and accurately placed.
Course features and atmosphere match the prompt.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Ensure the ball is even more obviously outside the tee markers if possible. Double-check that tee markers are distinct and clearly set the valid teeing area. Maintain realistic tee and ball sizing and accurate driver club depiction.

questions.title: What happens if you hit your first shot from the wrong place?
questions.question: If you hit your first shot on a hole, but your ball was not in the teeing area and you forget to fix it before you finish the hole, what happens in a competition?

choices.text: Nothing happens, your shot is fine.
You have to play again and add 2 shots to your score.
You cannot play in the competition anymore.
You add 2 shots to your score but your shot still counts.

questions.explanation: If you do not fix hitting your first shot from the wrong place, you are not allowed to keep playing in the competition.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The special place where you start each hole. Usually between two tee markers.
A game where you try to get the best score.

questions.teachingTip: Show children where the teeing area is and how to spot the tee markers before hitting.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids may think it's okay if you just keep playing.
Some may believe you only get a few extra shots as a penalty.

questions.title: Penalty for playing from outside the teeing area
questions.question: If you play your tee shot from outside the teeing area and do not fix the mistake before finishing the hole, what is the penalty in stroke play?

choices.text: There is no penalty, your shot counts.
You must replay your shot with 2 penalty strokes.
You are disqualified from the competition.
You get a two-stroke penalty but the shot still counts.

questions.explanation: If you fail to correct a tee shot played from outside the teeing area in stroke play, you are disqualified.
